objective: Owner's direction on 2026-10-28: agreeing to 'come back in at the open half of question 9: geometry from a law, with nothing drawn in advance', then 'You can start that work now actually'. It serves question 9 of docs/KNOT_INTUITION.md ('Which uniform, local law, not written on a space in advance, gives a shape that looks like a space of low dimension?') in the topology program. SURFACE-GLUING-20261024-001 showed that native gluing of three-place knots builds surfaces (pants decompositions) and that four knots see only the surface, while 'no geometry (metric, flatness) appears'. Questions: (1) what a uniform Boolean law of knots fixes of native geometry beyond topology: the type of curvature, an orientation at each knot, a scale; (2) which knots survive patterns of patterns, that is, are rebuilt by native gadgets made of their own copies (the coarse-graining a uniform law allows with nothing drawn), and in which shapes, hence which dimensions their self-similar towers can have; (3) the smallest enrichment (more places, weights, hubs, larger distinctions) under which a law could fix a two-dimensional scale. Standalone value relative to the nearest known work: hierarchical-lattice renormalization (Migdal and Kadanoff) takes the substitution and the lattice as given; Higuchi and Mezard (J. Stat. Mech. 2009, P12009) observe that decimation flows of hard random constraint problems produce linear constraints over GF(2); fan-out-two expressibility and Holant-clone results (Feder 2001; Dalmau and Ford 2003; Kazda, Kolmogorov and Rolinek) ask which relations two-occurrence gadgets define, not which relations are rebuilt by gadgets of their own copies or how fast the others die. Intuitions targeted: space from logic without a drawn space; the two/three boundary; patterns of patterns and the growth of emergent information; everything relational. No time constraints.
status: Complete 2026-10-29: geometry from a law, nothing drawn. Only parity is rebuilt by native gadgets of its own copies at three places (proved for every size; other knots lose excluded tuples and go free within three levels); no three-place knot orients a vertex; at four places (gadgets of up to three copies) only parity and a chained implication between pair parities survive, and no orienting knot does; counting (scoping) keeps only fields and pairwise bonds. Native Boolean laws fix topology and curvature type, and nothing geometric survives patterns of patterns. Next: research directions (hubs with counts and self-duality; universally influential cycles), deferred to the owner.
stop_rule: Stop when (i) the three-place statement (only the parity knots are rebuilt by native gadgets of their own copies, and the others lose excluded tuples at every level) is proved for all gadget sizes or reduced to a precise unproved lemma with exhaustive support; (ii) the four-place knots that survive native gadgets of two and three copies are classified, with their orientability; and (iii) the decision note states what geometry (curvature type, orientation, scale) a set-level Boolean law can fix and names the smallest enrichment that could fix a scale, with a recommendation. Record negative results.
title: Geometry from a law, with nothing drawn in advance
